kind: Read-only diagnosis of the owner's header menubar; no product or document repair
evidence: On arrival, actual browser screenshot and DOM showed all three header menus expanded and overlapping.
Each trigger had data-menu-value=file. Document/Source independently showed literal value=file for all three sibling menu nodes.
The insertion recipe seeds menubar.menu value=file; labels can change independently from that value.
B4MenubarMenu derives open from activeMenu() === value and passes the same value into Menubar.Menu.
The public descriptor exposes value as string without a sibling-uniqueness or active-menu-identity explanation; the duplicate-valued composition had been accepted.
diagnosis: All three siblings share the same active-menu identity, so selecting that identity satisfies every child's open comparison. The overlap follows shared identity rather than a z-index or heading-text fault.
responsibility: Agent changed labels without assigning distinct menu identities
Shared recipe default is reused across sibling insertions
Metadata and authoring validation did not prevent this collision
secondarySemantics: Menubar value identifies the currently open menu, not a selected product/page. Initial state macbook matches none of the three file identities.
preservationAndLimits: No source edits, Save, agent request, build, server restart or product fix.

Reading Document/Source dismissed the open menus. A subsequent Design-mode trigger click and ArrowDown left all menus closed; no switch to Interact, forced state change or successful single-action reproduction is claimed.
The original expanded state and source/code identity comparison establish this diagnosis. The raw owner document and page screenshot are not committed.
